title: First Matching Character From Both Ends
summary: Given a string s of lowercase English letters, find the smallest index i where the character at s[i] matches the character at s[n - i - 1].
statement: Given a string s of lowercase English letters, find the smallest index i where the character at s[i] matches the character at s[n - i - 1]. If no such index exists, return -1.
constraints: Compare each character with the character equally far from the other end.
Return the smallest index whose characters match.
Return -1 when no mirrored positions match.
hints: Map i to n-1-i at the opposite end.
Return immediately when the two characters agree.
Early return supplies the smallest matching index.
editorial: Early return supplies the smallest matching index.
